name: finfin
description: FinFin — tracker financeiro pessoal (sobe backend + frontend juntos)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
